title: Jute mallow Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Jute mallow Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Jute mallow nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen and phosphorus in saluyot, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Jute mallow nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your saluyot (jute mallow) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, iron and boron. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.credit: Maja Dumat, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But iron and boron stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which jute mallow nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a jute mallow nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest jute mallow nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in jute mallow

Older, lower leaves fade to yellowish green and yellow, and the yellowing moves up the plant. Stems are slender, hard and fibrous, leaves are small, and plants flower early with few tender tops to pick. You see it most at this stage: from about two weeks after sowing to the last picking.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in saluyot
Low organic matter, sandy soils, heavy rain, and repeated pickings without feeding.
How to tell it apart
Root knot nematodes, which stunt saluyot, also yellow plants. Check the roots. To be sure, lower leaves yellow first. The use a soil test for N, P and K.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

Saluyot responds well to organic fertilizer, with rates set by soil fertility and a soil test. A light side dressing of urea or ammonium sulfate after picking speeds regrowth. Follow the soil test for the rate.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, work compost or manure into the soil before sowing.
Phosphorus deficiency in jute mallow

Growth is slow without yellowing. Stems are slender and woody, leaves small and darker green, and some leaves show a reddish purple tint underneath. You see it most at this stage: seedling and early growth. Saluyot seedlings are already slow and weak against weeds.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in saluyot
Strongly acid or iron rich soils, low organic matter and cold or waterlogged soils.
How to tell it apart
The red stemmed Pula variety is naturally purplish. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus and pH.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency
Use complete 14 14 14 at sowing based on the soil test, and add compost. Follow the soil test for the rate.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, prepare the soil well with organic matter before sowing.
Potassium deficiency in jute mallow
Older leaves turn greyish green then bronze or yellowish brown, with brown edges that cup down. Stems are slender and roots are poor. You see it most at this stage: after several pickings.
Why potassium deficiency happens in saluyot
Sandy soils, heavy rain, and feeding with urea only.
How to tell it apart
Spider mite feeding bronzes leaves too, but with fine speckling and webbing under the leaves. To be sure, soil test for potassium.
What to apply for potassium deficiency
Use complete 14 14 14 or muriate of potash based on the soil test. Follow the soil test for the rate.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use complete fertilizer and compost rather than urea alone.
Iron deficiency in jute mallow

New leaves at the top turn light yellow between the veins, then over the whole leaf, while older leaves stay green. In a greenhouse study on white jute (a close relative of saluyot), iron was the first micronutrient to show symptoms when left out and one of the most limiting for growth. You see it most at this stage: seedling and early growth on alkaline soil.
Why iron deficiency happens in saluyot
Saluyot tolerates pH 4.5 to 8.0, and going beyond that range leaves less iron in the soil for the plant. Overliming and waterlogging add to it.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen shortage starts on the older leaves. To be sure, soil pH test.
What to apply for iron deficiency
Stop liming and spray ferrous sulfate or iron chelate on the leaves. Follow the product label.

Sold here with iron: **Ferrous Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Cleveland Industries Inc. (20 percent iron), **Ferrous Sulfate Monohydrate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (30 percent iron), **Grow More Liquid Chelate Iron with Sulfur** by Sagrex Corporation (5 percent iron and 3 percent sulfur) and **Biozome** by Manchem Industries, Inc. (12 percent S, 12 percent Zn, 3 percent Mn, 1 percent Mg, 1 percent Fe, 1 percent Cu, 0.5 percent B, 0.05 percent Mo). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [iron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/iron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep soil pH within 4.5 to 8.0, and add compost.
Boron deficiency in jute mallow

New leaves and leaf stalks are light, brittle and deformed, internodes are short and the shoot tips rosette, and roots grow poorly. In the white jute study, boron was one of the two micronutrients that most limited growth and its absence cut root growth. You see it most at this stage: early growth, especially on sandy soil in dry spells.
Why boron deficiency happens in saluyot
Sandy, leached soils, overliming, low organic matter and drought.
How to tell it apart
Mite damage also distorts young leaves. Look for mites under the leaves. To be sure, soil test for boron.
What to apply for boron deficiency
Apply boron only after a soil test, at a light rate. Follow the soil test. Do not repeat doses.

Sold here with boron: **Solubor** by Caldic Philippines Inc. (21 percent boron), **Etifert 11 (Borax Decahydrate)** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (11 percent boron), **YaraVita BORTRAC 150** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (11.1 percent boron) and **Grow More Liquid Chelate Boron** by Sagrex Corporation (10 percent boron). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [boron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/boron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep organic matter up.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any jute mallow nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your saluyot needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Jute mallow nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my saluyot leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: lower leaves turn pale yellow and plants grow thin, hard stems with few tender tops. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at iron deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in jute mallow?
items.a: Saluyot responds well to organic fertilizer, with rates set by soil fertility and a soil test. A light side dressing of urea or ammonium sulfate after picking speeds regrowth.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in jute mallow?
items.a: Use complete 14 14 14 at sowing based on the soil test, and add compost. Follow the soil test for the rate.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in jute mallow?
items.a: Use complete 14 14 14 or muriate of potash based on the soil test. Follow the soil test for the rate.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my saluyot lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the jute mallow nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
